PROP-01b-partial1-inv-028.text: Flash loan must not be usable to manipulate exchange rate within same tx for deposit/redeem profit.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-028.assertion: flash_loan cannot increase exchange_rate such that redeem in same tx yields more than deposited

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-029.text: Flash loan must not be usable to manipulate utilization rate to reduce borrow cost in same tx.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-029.assertion: flash_loan deposit cannot lower utilization to reduce borrow_rate for subsequent borrow in same tx

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-030.text: Self-liquidation must not yield net profit to the borrower who also acts as liquidator.

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-031.text: Dust positions must remain liquidatable; no minimum collateral threshold that prevents liquidation.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-031.assertion: forall oblig: risk_level(oblig) >= 1.0 => exists liquidation path regardless of position size

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-032.text: Outflow limit must not be bypassable by splitting borrows across multiple obligations or transactions.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-032.assertion: outflow_consumed(asset, 24h_window) == sum(all_borrows + all_withdrawals) regardless of obligation count

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-033.text: Borrow fee must be 0.3% for main assets and 1% for isolated/emerging; fee must not be avoidable.

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-034.text: Reserve factor portion of interest must go to protocol treasury, not to suppliers.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-034.assertion: reserve += interest_accumulated * reserve_factor && supply_rate = borrow_rate * utilization * (1-reserve_factor)

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-035.text: ObligationKey transfer must transfer full control; recipient can borrow/withdraw/repay immediately.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-035.assertion: transfer(key, recipient) => recipient has full {borrow, withdraw, repay} authority over obligation

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-036.text: Interest compounding must use correct elapsed time; manipulation of accrual timing must not inflate debt.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-036.assertion: interest = total_borrows * borrow_rate * (current_time - last_update_time); no double-counting

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-037.text: Pyth oracle confidence interval must be checked; low-confidence prices must be rejected.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-037.assertion: forall price_update: price.confidence / price.price <= max_confidence_ratio; reject otherwise

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-038.text: Cascading liquidations must not allow liquidator to extract more value than the unhealthy excess.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-038.assertion: collateral_seized * price_collateral <= (excess_debt + penalty) / price_debt for each liquidation step

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-039.text: E-mode collateral/borrow weight overrides must not allow under-collateralized positions.

PROP-01b-partial1-pre-006.text: Borrow amount must exceed minimum threshold to prevent dust-debt creation.
PROP-01b-partial1-pre-006.assertion: borrow(oblig, T, amt) requires amt >= min_borrow_amount(T)

PROP-01b-partial1-post-005.text: After full repayment, obligation.debts[T] must equal exactly 0 with no residual dust.

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-040.text: Reward distribution index must be updated before any position change to prevent stale reward claims.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-040.assertion: forall position_change: update_reward_index() called before deposit/withdraw/borrow/repay

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-041.text: Zero-share dilution must be prevented; depositing into a pool with rewards must not dilute existing claimants.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-041.assertion: deposit with zero sCoin balance must not claim accumulated rewards from prior depositors

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-042.text: ADL (auto-deleveraging) must only trigger under extreme conditions and must not unfairly target positions.
PROP-01b-partial1-inv-042.assertion: ADL requires protocol-wide insolvency condition; selection must be deterministic and fair

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-001.text: First deposit to empty reserve must not allow exchange rate manipulation via donation attack.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-001.assertion: forall deposit(amt) when total_supply == 0: minted_ctokens == amt (exchange_rate = 1.0, no inflation possible)

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-002.text: Exchange rate must not decrease due to direct underlying token donation to reserve.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-002.assertion: forall t1 < t2: exchange_rate(t2) >= exchange_rate(t1) absent liquidation revenue

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-003.text: cToken mint amount must round down (against depositor) to prevent exchange rate dilution.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-003.assertion: forall mint(amt): minted_ctokens == floor(amt / exchange_rate), never ceil

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-004.text: cToken burn/redeem must round down (against withdrawer) to prevent reserve drain.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-004.assertion: forall burn(ct): redeemed_underlying == floor(ct * exchange_rate), never ceil

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-005.text: Reserve accounting: cash + debt - cash_reserve must equal total depositor value at all times.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-005.assertion: forall op: exchange_rate * total_supply == cash + debt - cash_reserve

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-006.text: Cash must always be >= cash_reserve to prevent borrowing protocol revenue.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-007.text: Borrow index must be monotonically non-decreasing across all interest accruals.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-007.assertion: forall accrue(t1, t2) where t1 < t2: borrow_index(t2) >= borrow_index(t1)

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-008.text: repay_fee_rate must be used as reserve_factor (protocol revenue share), not as a repay fee.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-008.assertion: accrue_interest: cash_reserve += reserve_factor * interest_accumulated (not repay_fee * repay_amount)

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-009.text: Interest rate model must be continuous at kink points with no discontinuity.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-009.assertion: calc_interest(mid_kink) from low segment == calc_interest(mid_kink) from mid segment

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-010.text: Utilization rate must stay in [0, 1] range; util > 1 indicates accounting error.

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-001.text: Interest must be accrued before any borrow operation to prevent stale index exploitation.
PROP-01b-partial2-pre-001.assertion: forall borrow(obl, amt): accrue_interest(reserve, now) called before try_borrow_asset()

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-002.text: Interest must be accrued before repay to ensure correct debt calculation.
PROP-01b-partial2-pre-002.assertion: forall repay(obl, amt): accrue_interest(reserve, now) called before repay_debt()

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-003.text: All obligation debts and collaterals must have interest refreshed before liquidation safety check.
PROP-01b-partial2-pre-003.assertion: forall liquidate(obl): refresh_obligation_assets_interest(all) called before ensure_liquidate_allowed

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-004.text: Obligation safety check must use fresh oracle prices, not cached or stale values.
PROP-01b-partial2-pre-004.assertion: forall safety_check(obl): oracle.get_price(clock) uses current clock, price freshness validated

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-005.text: Obligation must belong to the target market for all lending operations.

PROP-01b-partial2-post-001.text: Obligation must remain safe (weighted_debt <= weighted_collateral) after borrow.

PROP-01b-partial2-post-002.text: Obligation must remain safe after withdrawal of collateral.

PROP-01b-partial2-post-003.text: Debt must be >= min_borrow_amount or exactly zero after borrow or repay (no dust debt).
PROP-01b-partial2-post-003.assertion: forall borrow_or_repay(obl, type): post(debt(type) >= min_borrow || debt(type) == 0)

PROP-01b-partial2-post-004.text: Flash loan repay must return exactly borrowed amount + fee; no partial repayment allowed.
PROP-01b-partial2-post-004.assertion: forall repay_flash_loan(coin, loan): coin.value() == loan.amount + loan.fee

PROP-01b-partial2-post-005.text: Flash loan fee must be non-zero to prevent free flash loans draining protocol revenue.
PROP-01b-partial2-post-005.assertion: forall borrow_flash_loan(amt): fee = flash_loan_fee_rate * amt > 0, abort if fee == 0

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-011.text: Flash loan hot potato must prevent re-entrancy; only one flash loan active per market at a time.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-012.text: An asset cannot be simultaneously used as collateral and borrowed in the same obligation.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-013.text: Liquidation must only proceed when obligation is unsafe (weighted_debts > weighted_collateral).

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-014.text: Liquidation close_factor must limit repay amount unless position is near bad debt.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-014.assertion: if collateral > 1.01 * debts: repay_amount <= close_factor * total_debt; bypass only near bad debt

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-015.text: Seized cTokens in liquidation must not exceed obligation's total cToken balance for that collateral.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-016.text: Liquidation revenue factor portion must go to protocol reserve, not liquidator.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-016.assertion: liquidate: protocol_seize == revenue_factor * redeem_amount; added to cash_reserve

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-017.text: Liquidation seize calculation must use correct formula with oracle prices and exchange rate.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-018.text: Rate limiter outflow sum across all segments in a cycle must not exceed outflow_limit.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-018.assertion: forall op: sum(segments[i].value for i in cycle) + new_value <= outflow_limit

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-019.text: Rate limiter reduce_outflow must only affect current segment, not historical segments.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-019.assertion: reduce_outflow(now, val): only segments[(now / seg_duration) % n].value reduced

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-020.text: ADL liquidation_ltv must decrease hourly to progressively allow more liquidations.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-020.assertion: adl_ltv(t2) <= adl_ltv(t1) for t2 > t1 (monotonically decreasing via saturating_sub)

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-021.text: ADL liquidation incentive must be capped by normal liquidation_incentive to prevent excess seizure.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-022.text: Flash loan must not alter reserve cash or debt accounting fields (temporary withdrawal only).
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-022.assertion: borrow_flash_loan: reserve.cash unchanged, reserve.debt unchanged; only underlying_balance affected

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-023.text: Permission bitmask check must validate both whitelist membership and specific permission bit.
